national_news.title: Government Approves Incentive Scheme to Promote Domestic PNG Connections
bullets: The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas approved an Incentive Scheme for Promotion of Domestic PNG Connections effective from the 1st of next month.

The scheme incentivises City Gas Distribution (CGD) companies by allocating an additional 200 Standard Cubic Meters of domestically-produced lower-priced gas for every incremental billed Domestic PNG connection.
Currently, India has 1.74 crore domestic Piped Natural Gas (PNG) connections, and the scheme is implemented in two tranches spanning six months.

national_news.title: Indian Shuttlers Advance at BWF World Championships
bullets: The mixed doubles pair of Dhruv Kapila and Tanisha Crasto reached the pre-quarterfinals of the BWF World Championships in New Delhi.
Top Indian pairs like Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty also advanced to the pre-quarterfinals.
Young shuttler Ayush Shetty produced a major upset by defeating world number one Shi Yu Qi of China earlier in the tournament.

national_news.title: Indian Badminton Players Continue Strong Run at World Championships
bullets: Indian ace shuttler Lakshya Sen advanced to the men's singles second round at the BWF Badminton World Championships after defeating Austria's Collins Filimon.
Women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand advanced to the pre-quarterfinals.
Unnati Hooda also advanced to the next round in the women's singles category.

national_news.title: Rishabh Pant Hits Milestone of 100 Test Sixes
bullets: Rishabh Pant became the first Indian player and only the fourth in the world to hit 100 sixes in Test cricket during the first Test against Sri Lanka in Galle.
Pant achieved the milestone in just his 51st Test, making him the fastest player to complete 100 sixes in the format.
India set Sri Lanka a target of 372 runs in the match, with contributions from top-scorer Devdutt Padikkal and bowler Manav Suthar.

national_news.title: Overview of News Services Division of All India Radio
bullets: The News Services Division (NSD) of All India Radio operates 24X7, broadcasting 607 bulletins daily in 92 languages and dialects.
News broadcasting in India originated with the Indian Broadcasting Company in Bombay on July 23, 1927, before coming under government control and being renamed All India Radio in 1936.
NSD is headed by a Director General (News) from the Indian Information Service and manages regional units, external services, and multi-lingual news dissemination.

national_news.title: PIB Dehradun Organises Regional Media Workshop 'Vartalaap' in Chamoli
bullets: The Press Information Bureau (PIB), Dehradun, organised a regional media workshop titled 'Vartalaap' in Gopeshwar, Chamoli, on August 20.
The workshop aimed to bridge the communication gap between the government and local print, electronic, and digital media in rural and border areas.
Key themes discussed included Central welfare schemes, women and youth empowerment, farmer welfare, GI tags, and the One District One Product (ODOP) initiative.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman Proposes Month-Long Campaign for Youth Banking
bullets: The two-day PSB Confluence 2026 was organised by the Department of Financial Services (DFS), Ministry of Finance, concluding with a focus on seven key growth themes.
Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced a focused, month-long campaign starting October 2, 2026, for youth above 16 years to integrate them into the formal financial system.
The initiative will utilize a common online portal and physical outreach via educational institutions to support youth financial needs across education, employment, and entrepreneurship.

national_news.title: 97th Annual General Meeting of ICAR Society Emphasises Integrated Farming
bullets: The 97th Annual General Meeting of the ICAR Society was held at the National Agricultural Science Complex (NASC), New Delhi, chaired by Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan.
The meeting emphasized integrated farming systems, soil health, balanced fertilizer use, and timely access to quality seeds to diversify the incomes of small and marginal farmers.
Leaders stressed building a demand-driven research ecosystem and strengthening India's export viability through quality, processing, and compliance with global standards.

national_news.title: PIB Gangtok Conducts Media Workshop on VB-G RAM G and Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyan
bullets: The Press Information Bureau (PIB), Gangtok, organised a 'Vartalap' programme focusing on the VB-G RAM G scheme and the Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyan in Sikkim.
Discussions highlighted the implementation, outreach, and rural development impact of the VB-G RAM G scheme in the state.
Law enforcement authorities and media representatives collaborated to address substance abuse and promote anti-narcotics measures under the Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyan.

national_news.title: Agriculture and Rural Development Ministries Adopt 'Shakti Ki Saptadhara' Roadmap
bullets: The Ministries of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare and Rural Development organised a commitment programme to implement the 'Shakti Ki Saptadhara' vision announced by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan administered a collective pledge to officials, scientists, farmers, and FPOs to build a self-reliant and prosperous India.
The roadmap focuses on enhancing agricultural productivity, product quality, safety, and establishing a strong global footprint for Indian agricultural exports.

national_news.title: India’s Free Trade Agreements and Export Performance in FY 2025-26
bullets: In FY 2025-26, India's combined merchandise and services exports reached a record US$ 863.1 billion, with merchandise exports at US$ 441.8 billion.
During April-June 2026, combined exports rose by 11.37% year-on-year to an estimated US$ 232.73 billion.
The India-UAE CEPA, which came into force on May 1, 2022, was India's largest individual FTA export market with merchandise exports worth US$ 37,359.11 million in FY 2025-26.

national_news.title: Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports Announces National Sports Awards 2025
bullets: The National Sports Awards 2025 selection committee was chaired by former Supreme Court Judge Justice (Retd.) Arun Kumar Mishra.
Prestigious Arjuna Awards 2025 were conferred on prominent sportspersons including Tejaswin Shankar, Priyanka Goswami, Vidit Santosh Gujarathi, and Lalremsiami.
Army Paralympic Node, Pune, was awarded the Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar 2025 for sports promotion and development.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Cabinet Clears Two Sugar Mill Projects Worth Rs 422.5 Crore in East Champaran
bullets: The Bihar cabinet approved two sugar mill projects with a combined investment of Rs 422.5 crore in the East Champaran district.
Kolkata-based Shree Ganesh Sugar Mills Private Limited received approval for a Rs 180 crore project featuring a 5,000 TCD sugar mill and distillery in Chorma, Pakridayal block.
Rajshree Sugars secured approval for a Rs 242.5 crore project at Kanjahiya Tola in Kotwa block, comprising a 5,000 TCD sugar mill, a 28 MW co-generation plant, and a 60 KLPD distillery.
These projects aim to boost the rural economy, provide a direct local market for sugarcane farmers in Bihar and Nepal's Terai region, and create employment opportunities.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Agri-PV Summit 2026 Focuses on Combining Farming with Solar Energy
bullets: The Bihar Agri-PV Summit 2026 was held in Patna to promote the integration of agriculture and solar energy.
Experts highlighted the potential of agri-photovoltaic (PV) models in Bihar to optimize limited fertile land and boost farmers' incomes.
The initiative supports the state's broader goals of achieving clean and renewable energy targets through cross-sector coordination.

bihar_news.title: Sherghati-Kajree New Broad Gauge Line Project Sanctioned for Bihar and Jharkhand
bullets: The Sherghati-Kajree New Broad Gauge Line Project has been officially sanctioned connecting Bihar and Jharkhand.
The infrastructure project entails the development of a 107.89 km long new Broad Gauge railway line.
It aims to improve regional connectivity and transport infrastructure between Sherghati in Bihar and Kajree in Jharkhand.

bihar_news.title: Legal Status of Passports and Electoral Verification in India
bullets: The Ministry of External Affairs clarified that an Indian passport is primarily a travel document under the Passports Act, 1967, rather than conclusive proof of citizenship.

The Supreme Court, in Association for Democratic Reforms v. Election Commission of India (May 2026), upheld the EC's authority to conduct the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) in Bihar under Article 324.
Conclusive determination of citizenship remains exclusively under the Citizenship Act, 1955, and designated authorities, distinct from identity documents like Aadhaar or voter ID.

bihar_news.title: Prashant Kishor Discusses Patna Traffic Plan with Bihar DGP
bullets: Jan Suraaj Party founder and Bankipur MLA Prashant Kishor met Bihar DGP Vinay Kumar on August 18, 2026.
Discussions focused on formulating a three-year inter-departmental plan to improve traffic management in Patna and Bankipur.
Other issues raised included alleged police extortion targeting street vendors and rising drug usage among street children.

bihar_news.title: India's Electoral System and Global Recognition
bullets: US President Donald Trump praised India's voter identification framework and cited it as an example for the United States during discussions with CEC Gyanesh Kumar.
India's electoral framework is administered by the Election Commission of India under constitutional provisions, managing massive turnouts like the 642 million voters in 2024.
The system incorporates multi-layered safeguards including Booth Level Officers, EPIC cards, EVMs with VVPAT, and active participation of political party agents.

bihar_news.title: Bihar STET 2026 Registration Begins for Papers 1 and 2
bullets: The Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) commenced the registration process for the Bihar Secondary Teacher Eligibility Test (STET) 2026.
Paper 1 is for candidates aiming to teach Classes 9 and 10, while Paper 2 is for Classes 11 and 12 teaching positions.
Eligibility requires specific graduation/post-graduation degrees with B.Ed., with a 5% relaxation for reserved categories such as SC, ST, EBC, BC, and PwBD.

bihar_news.title: Bihar's Critical Mineral Potential Offers New Investment Opportunities
bullets: Bihar Deputy Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary highlighted the state's critical mineral potential to attract investments.
The initiative aims to boost innovation, mining, and industrial infrastructure development in the state.
The focus is on harnessing local mineral and stone resources to meet growing economic and infrastructure demands.

bihar_news.title: Patna Metro Receives INR 628.32 Crore Funding
bullets: Patna Metro secured INR 628.32 crore under the Central government's capital investment scheme.
The additional funding accelerates construction work across the metro project's corridors.
The financial support is part of the central push for urban infrastructure development in Bihar.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Allocate Over 30 Coal Blocks to Boost Mining
bullets: The Bihar government announced plans to allocate more than 30 coal blocks to boost the mining sector.
The allocation strategy aims to meet the growing infrastructure and energy demands of the state by utilizing local minerals.
The initiative marks a significant push towards expanding industrial and mining operations in Bihar.

bihar_news.title: Bihar initiates site survey for 129 EV charging stations across 23 districts
bullets: Site surveys have begun for setting up 129 Electric Vehicle (EV) charging stations across 23 districts in Bihar.
The initiative aims to develop a robust charging network to promote electric mobility and green infrastructure in the state.
The project is a priority for the state government's sustainable transport and clean energy goals.

bihar_news.title: Bihar inaugurates mineral block auctions and outlines upcoming mining targets
bullets: Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary inaugurated the auction of strategic mineral blocks and a workshop on NMEDT organized by the Ministry of Coal and Mines.
Over 30 of the 44 surveyed coal and mineral blocks are targeted for allocation before September 30, with mining operations starting on October 15.
Key mineral reserves are distributed across districts like Rohtas (limestone), Aurangabad, Jehanabad, Jamui, Gaya, Banka, and Bhagalpur, with royalties dedicated to public welfare.
